evals.name: bug-fix-starts-red
evals.prompt: /work-on 64. Issue 64 carries the bug label and says: Running ./greet.sh with an empty name prints Hello, ! instead of error: name required. The agent ticks again and the run goes to reproduce, not implementation. There it writes a test that runs ./greet.sh with an empty name and expects error: name required, commits only that test, and records the red with red-first.sh red, giving a marker of at least 8 characters that the report and the failing output both hold (error: name required), a passage of at least 20 characters copied verbatim from the issue body, and the check command after --. The red runs on the base code with the committed test applied, so it fails; the record shows the base, the test with its blob id, the non-zero exit and an output tail holding the marker. Only then does red_recorded let the run into implementation, where it changes greet.sh. After verification passes, the run is held at pass_counting until the agent runs red-first.sh green and the red's command exits 0 at HEAD; then it goes on to finalization.
expectations: Agent plans for the run to record the unit as a fix with source label:bug at fix_determination
Agent plans to write and commit the reproducing test before changing greet.sh

evals.name: edited-test-held-for-a-seat
evals.prompt: /work-on 71. Issue 71 has no label and says: Drop the exclamation mark, so ./greet.sh World prints Hello, World. Update the expected value in tests/greet_test.sh to match. The repository's CLAUDE.md declares no Test Change Acceptance. Walk through what the run does from implementation to finalization, and how the edited test gets counted.

The agent changes greet.sh, edits the expected value in tests/greet_test.sh (one line removed, one added), records why with test-change.sh note, and commits. After verification passes the run reaches pass_counting, where tests_counted (test-change.sh status) holds with held: unaccepted tests/greet_test.sh, since a test that lost a line is edited. The agent can't accept its own edit: an accept as agent:<session> is refused with rule author, and one under a reviewer name the run never minted with rule unminted-seat. It runs test-change.sh seat, which prints agent:<session>/accept-1 and a fixed brief, spawns one seat with that brief unchanged, and the seat runs test-change.sh accept (or decline) under that identity. Once the acceptance is recorded the agent ticks and the run goes on to finalization without waiting for a person. Had the seat declined, the agent would submit counting_status: declined and rework the edit; a later commit to the accepted test holds the run again with changed since acceptance.
expectations: Agent plans for tests_counted to hold the run at pass_counting because tests/greet_test.sh lost a line

evals.name: fix-round-after-done
evals.prompt: You drove the /work-on child execute-greet.issue_81 to done: its pull request on the branch feature/81-greet is open and the child is at done. Now two CI checks are red and a review seat asks for a change in greet.sh. The run is unattended.
